prompt: A image reveal where the main image comes first, followed by all the elements coming up and down, with some bounciness when it makes sense. It shuold take the real estate image itself, and the real estate agent image to place on the bottom avatar corner. The image should fill the whole space and then be covered by the rest of the elements, and the background shuold be transparent
description: A foto do imóvel revela-se em íris a ocupar o quadro inteiro; depois o painel azul com corte diagonal sobe, a pill de estado e a etiqueta de preço caem com ressalto e os textos, a pill de contacto, o avatar do agente, o logótipo e a linha legal entram em cascata sobre fundo transparente.
param_schema: { "src"?: image, "avatar"?: image, "logo"?: image, "tag"?: string, "price"?: string, "location"?: string, "title"?: string, "facts"?: string, "cta"?: string, "name"?: string, "logoText"?: string, "logoSub"?: string, "legal"?: string }
